description:
The Most Stable, Most Powerful 4-Wheel E-Bike Ever Built

If you want the ultimate combination of stability, comfort, and power, the ANYterrain Dual-Motor 4-Wheel Recumbent E-Bike delivers a riding experience unlike anything else on the market.

With four fat tires, dual motors, and dual batteries, this innovative design provides unmatched confidence for riders who want to explore farther, climb steeper hills, and ride more comfortably than ever before.

Whether you're cruising your neighborhood, exploring trails, running errands, or riding with a passenger, the ANYterrain makes every ride easier, smoother, and more enjoyable.

Massive Dual Motor Power — 1,500 Watts

The new ANYterrain is equipped with two rear-mounted 750-watt motors, giving you the ability to ride with:

• One motor for efficient cruising

• Both motors for maximum power

When both motors are engaged, you get 1,500 watts of combined power, making steep hills, heavy riders, cargo loads, and passenger riding dramatically easier.

No struggling on inclines.

No worrying about losing momentum.

Just smooth, confident climbing power whenever you need it.

Huge Dual Battery System — 40Ah Capacity

To support the dual motors, the ANYterrain now features two 48V 20Ah batteries, giving you a combined 40Ah of battery capacity.

This dramatically extends your range so you can ride up to 80 miles on a single charge depending on terrain and assist level.

• Longer adventures

• Fewer charging stops

• Greater riding freedom

The Stability of Four Wheels

Unlike traditional bikes or even three-wheel trikes, the ANYterrain offers the security of four wheels planted firmly on the ground.

• Two 20” x 4” rear fat tires

• Two 16” x 4” front fat tires

This quad-wheel setup provides exceptional stability while riding on pavement, gravel, dirt paths, or trails.

The tilting front steering system allows both front wheels to stay connected to the ground while turning, making cornering feel natural, smooth, and controlled.

For many riders, it’s the most confidence-inspiring ride they’ve ever experienced.

Luxury Recumbent Comfort

The ANYterrain is designed for riders who want to enjoy long rides without discomfort.

• Swiveling seat for easy mounting and dismounting

• Adjustable seat position for different rider heights

• Armrests and headrest for full upper body support

• Integrated seat belt for additional security

The relaxed forward pedaling position reduces strain on your back, wrists, shoulders, and knees—making this an excellent option for riders who want a more comfortable riding posture.

Bring a Passenger or Carry More

The rear of the ANYterrain can be configured for utility or shared rides.

• A large rear basket for groceries, gear, and errands

• Or a rear passenger seat so a friend, partner, or grandchild can ride along

This flexibility transforms the ANYterrain into a versatile four-wheel transportation vehicle for both fun and everyday use.

Built-In Safety Features

The ANYterrain comes fully equipped with essential safety technology so you can ride confidently day or night.

• Bright front headlight

• Brake-activated rear lights

• Integrated turn signals

• Loud horn for visibility in traffic

• Four hydraulic disc brakes for strong stopping power

Every ride feels safe, controlled, and predictable.

Key Features at a Glance

A New Level of Freedom

The ANYterrain Dual-Motor 4-Wheel Recumbent E-Bike isn't just an e-bike.

It’s a new category of ultra-stable electric mobility designed for riders who want comfort, power, and confidence all in one machine.

With four-wheel stability, dual-motor power, and massive battery capacity, this is the most capable recumbent e-bike we’ve ever built.

Ride farther.

Climb easier.

Feel more stable.

Experience the ANYterrain.
